description: Index of content GridCraft read from an OOXML (.xlsx/.xlsm) file, does not model, and carries VERBATIM so that exporting to OOXML again loses nothing (node type x.gridcraft.ooxml). The parts are opaque to this profile: custom XML, external-link records, connections, query tables, printer settings, form controls, OLE objects and their preview images, and similar. Each part's bytes are a separate file of this node. A reader that does not write OOXML skips this node and loses nothing of the spreadsheet. NOTHING here is executed or fetched.

elements.description: Raw XML elements of the owning part that refer to kept parts by relationship id.

slot.description: Where in the owning part it belongs, e.g. `externalReferences`, `oleObjects`, `controls`. Free text: content, never a reference - a reader shows or stores it and never resolves it as a path or address.

xml.description: The element as XML text, with the namespace declarations it needs. Free text: content, never a reference - a reader shows or stores it and never resolves it as a path or address.

owner.description: What the content belongs to: the workbook (which also holds package-level content) or one sheet.

package_rels.description: Relationships of the source package root to kept parts (workbook owner only).

items.description: An OPC relationship (ECMA-376 Part 2) from the owner, or from a kept part, to a kept part or to something outside the source file.

external.description: true: the target is outside the source file.

id.description: The relationship id in the source file, e.g. `rId7`. Free text: content, never a reference - a reader shows or stores it and never resolves it as a path or address.

rel_type.description: The relationship type URI. An identifier, never fetched. Free text: content, never a reference - a reader shows or stores it and never resolves it as a path or address.

target.description: For an internal relationship: the `name` of the kept part it points to. For an external one (`external` true): the raw target recorded in the source file - a URL or a path on the computer that wrote it. A NOTE: this document does not depend on it and a reader MUST NOT open it. Free text: content, never a reference - a reader shows or stores it and never resolves it as a path or address.

content_type.description: The part's content type in the source package. Free text: content, never a reference - a reader shows or stores it and never resolves it as a path or address.

file_name.description: The file of THIS node that holds the part's bytes verbatim: the file of this node whose path ends in `/` + this name (for example `part-0001.bin`), in the same directory as this index.

name.description: The part's name in the source OOXML package, without a leading `/`, e.g. `xl/ctrlProps/ctrlProp1.xml`. A name inside the SOURCE package, not a path in this package. Free text: content, never a reference - a reader shows or stores it and never resolves it as a path or address.
